meaning: The probe is shorting at power on; the boiler does not turn on.
causes: Probe tip touching a metal surface
checks: Turn off the boiler and check the probe wiring connection.
Turn off the boiler, drain it and remove the control to check whether the probe tip touches a metal surface.

meaning: Internal fault; the boiler does not turn on.
checks: Press the test button for more than 1 second until the red LED turns off, or power cycle to reset.
If it continues, replace the control.
